request.objective: Validate a portable file catalog and report duplicates without filesystem access
request.task:
Implement catalog(entries): entries is a list of dicts with exactly path,size,sha256. path must be a nonempty portable POSIX relative path, no backslash, colon, leading slash, empty component, . or .. component, NUL/newline. Unicode allowed. size must be integer >=0, bool forbidden. sha256 must be exactly64 lowercase hex characters. Reject malformed entries and duplicate paths with ValueError. Return new list of dicts sorted by path; never mutate input or access filesystem. Implement duplicate_groups(entries) using validated catalog: return lists of paths having same (size,sha256), each group sorted, only groups of >=2, groups sorted lexicographically. CLI reads JSON array stdin; outputs JSON {"catalog":...,"duplicates":...} ensure_ascii=False; invalid ->exit2 concise stderr. Document contract, Unicode, examples, no filesystem I/O. Modify module.py and README.md only. Never edit tests/build/.autopilot. Run python test_module.py and python build.py.

```json
}
```
